t: The Wright Brothers Moment: From Vibe Coding to AI-on-Rails Determinism
s: Pipulate achieves a "Wright Brothers Moment" by enabling unbounded, power-law scaling for FOSS+AI via a deterministic, single-tenant "AI-on-Rails" architecture. This distributed "Swarm Model" leverages Nix for precise environment replication, moving beyond human-bounded "vibe coding" to robust automation.
sub: Normal vs. Pareto Distribution in Software Scaling (Mediocristan vs. Extremistan)
FOSS + AI: Unbounded Users (Bots) and Compound Power Law
AI-on-Rails: Swarm Model & Nix for Environment Replication
